The rule states Eighth Amendment, due-process, and innocent-owner propositions, but the cited lake records contain no holding text or pinpoint quotes, no text/ opinion files are present, and no two affirmative black-letter approvals are disclosed. The rule also cites only Austin, Bajakajian, and Timbs, leaving its due-process and innocent-owner components unsupported by the citations in the callout.
defect.proposed_fix: Add disclosed opinion text or lake holding/pinpoint support for each component, cite the due-process and innocent-owner authorities in the rule itself, and provide the required two affirmative black-letter approvals; otherwise narrow the rule to the propositions actually supported by disclosed authorities.

reasons: Default-to-refuted applies because no disclosed opinion text or lake holding/pinpoint quotes verify the breadth of the black-letter rule.

The black-letter-specific requirement of at least two affirmative approvals is not satisfied by any disclosed file.
residual_risks: The proposition may be substantively correct, but it is not verifiable from this disclosed record set.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Split the black-letter rule into separately cited components: Excessive Fines, due process/timeliness, and innocent-owner defense.
